user.title: BMW CarData MQTT Bridge
user.description: Enter your BMW CarData credentials. You can find both on the BMW CarData portal in your My BMW account (the GCID is shown as the MQTT username).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BMW CarData
reauth_confirm.description: Your BMW session expired. Continue to log in again with your BMW account.

{url}

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach BMW to start the login. Check your Client ID and try again.

init.title: BMW CarData MQTT Bridge options
init.description: Optionally republish BMW signals to your Home Assistant MQTT broker (requires the MQTT integration, e.g. the Mosquitto broker). Entities are always created regardless of this setting.
